The release jar bundles these unmodified third-party tools, used only to build
the patched classes on the user's machine:

- Vineflower 1.11.1 (decompiler) - Apache License 2.0
  https://github.com/Vineflower/vineflower
- Eclipse Compiler for Java (ECJ) 3.46.100 - Eclipse Public License 2.0
  https://github.com/eclipse-jdt/eclipse.jdt.core
  Source: https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/eclipse/jdt/ecj/3.46.100/
